panels.description: End to end request latency measured in seconds.
panels.title: E2E Request Latency

panels.description: Number of tokens processed per second
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Inter-token latency in seconds, measured between consecutive streamed outputs. It approximates TPOT when each output contains one token, but differs from request-level TPOT under speculative decoding or varying aggregation weights.
panels.title: Inter Token Latency

panels.description: Per-request Time Per Output Token (TPOT) in seconds, computed as (end-to-end latency - TTFT) divided by the number of output tokens minus one. Requests with no more than one output token are recorded as zero; vllm bench serve excludes these requests from its TPOT statistics.
panels.title: Time Per Output Token (TPOT)

panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state
panels.title: Scheduler State

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency in seconds.
panels.title: Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM.
panels.title: Cache Utilization

panels.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.
panels.title: Finish Reason
Max Generation Token in Sequence Group
Prefix Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Fraction of queried prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. External = KV connector cache (only present when a KV connector is configured).

panels.title: Preemptions
panels.description: Requests preempted per second (KV cache pressure). Sustained non-zero values mean the engine is over capacity.

panels.title: Tokens per Engine Step
panels.description: Distribution of tokens processed per engine step (batch size in tokens).

panels.title: Request Inference Time
panels.description: Time each request spent in the RUNNING phase (prefill + decode, excludes queueing).

panels.title: Cached Prompt Tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second: total vs. served from cache (local + external), plus breakdown by source.
